column3: A bike costs £240. You pay £180. How much is left to pay?
A coach has 54 seats. Six are empty. How many are occupied?
Five boxes hold 36 oranges each. How many oranges are there?
A film starts at 6:45 p.m. and lasts 2 hours. When does it end?
A rope is 15 m long. One-third is cut off. How much remains?
A shirt costs £40. It is reduced by 25%. What is the new price?
Sam walks 1.2 km to school and 1.2 km home. How far does he walk?
A recipe needs 250 g of flour. How much is needed for 4 batches?
A class reads 18 books each month. How many books are read in 6 months?
A tank holds 500 L. It contains 275 L. How much more will fill it?
A train travels 85 km each hour. How far does it travel in 4 hours?
Ben saves £12 each week for 8 weeks. How much does he save?
Three friends share £45 equally. How much does each receive?
A shop sells 245 toys in May and 178 in June. How many toys are sold?
A runner completes 12 laps. Each lap is 400 m. How far does the runner travel?
